RowDefinition: Union of published EEG files and confirmed original S3 signal exports for participants in the selected releases. Task aliases are combined only when unambiguous; differing duplicate exports remain candidate rows.

MissingValues.n/a: Unknown or not assessed; recommendations are assigned separately from missing metric values

Scope: Recommendation concerns EEG use for the named task after ordinary preprocessing. ET association and inclusion are reported separately; neither certifies ET synchronization or signal quality

hed_feedback_annotated.Description: Number of contrast targets with one consistent response and a recorded target-end marker; visual-feedback HED is attached to that end marker. No new event onset or outcome is invented

hed_feedback_unresolved.Description: Number of inspected contrast targets lacking an unambiguous feedback association; original response/outcome cells remain unchanged

hed_feedback_reasons.Description: Semicolon-separated controlled reasons for unresolved feedback annotations

Levels.none: No unresolved feedback association among inspected targets
Levels.missing_end: Target has no end marker before another target, boundary, task start or file end
Levels.missing_response: No response before the target-end marker
Levels.multiple_responses: More than one response before the target-end marker
Levels.unknown_task_context: A target label occurs without an established contrast-task segment
Levels.inconsistent_outcome_or_time: Response outcome disagrees with target/response side, lacks a supported description, or the target/end timing is not increasing

hed_contrast_unusual_timing.Description: Number of target/end intervals outside 2.4 seconds ± 50 ms. The recording keeps point descriptions of target identity instead of fixed 1.6/0.8-second HED phases. Feedback on these trials is a point annotation without an asserted 400 ms duration

recording_id.Description: Stable row identifier; not necessarily a BIDS filename

source_release.Description: Identifier of the original published EEG release, where known

task.Description: Intended task whose usability is assessed in this row

run.Description: Known block/run number; n/a if absent or unresolved

upstream_status.Description: Original available/caution/unavailable entry, retained verbatim from participants.tsv when its recording identity is supported. Ambiguous unmatched source candidates use n/a. It is not translated into our recommendation

in_s3.Description: A standalone original EEG export for this recording has been confirmed on S3. n/a if matching is ambiguous, or no match exists but the participant has unidentified source exports

in_upstream_bids.Description: A standalone EEG file exists in the original published BIDS release

in_bids.Description: A standalone EEG file exists in the delivered release described by this table

et_associated.Description: A complete SMI samples/events pair is associated by supported task matching. 0 means no pair matched in the supplied ET tree; it does not establish absence of other original ET formats or certify synchronization

et_in_bids.Description: Associated ET data are present in standard BIDS form in the delivered release; this is not a signal-quality verdict

embedded_in.Description: recording_id of another row whose EEG file contains this task segment; n/a when no such relationship is established

bids_path.Description: Relative path from the delivered release root to the standalone EEG file; n/a if none

required_action.Description: Controlled action code; descriptions are defined once here instead of repeated as row prose

Levels.none: No special recovery or repair beyond ordinary task selection and preprocessing
Levels.extract_task: Extract the verified task segment, preserve its time mapping and create the correctly named recording
Levels.convert_source: Convert a verified usable original source into the delivered BIDS collection
Levels.exclude: Do not use this recording for the assessed EEG task
Levels.review: Review the unresolved evidence before relying on this recording

Levels.unreviewed: No completed review for the stated analysis scope
Levels.partial: Only some required checks have been completed
Levels.reviewed: The specified human review is complete

review_status.Description: Extent of human review; assigning an automatic recommendation does not change this field

recommendation.Description: EEG screening recommendation for the named task in the delivered release after ordinary preprocessing. Separate from the original upstream_status; see recommendation_method and recommendation_reasons

Levels.available: A delivered EEG recording has no relevant obstacle detected by the available checks; not a signal-quality certification
Levels.caution: A delivered EEG recording has a known caveat or incomplete assessment requiring consideration before use
Levels.unavailable: No standalone EEG recording is delivered for this row, or this specific recording is confirmed unusable. Reasons distinguish these cases; missing data are not declared irrecoverable

ReviewProtocol: Automatic EEG screening assigns provisional recommendations using RecommendationRules; --reviews overrides them. Human review_status is preserved. ET availability, timing and missingness must be evaluated separately for joint EEG/ET analyses.

source_task.Description: Original S3 export name; n/a when unmatched

source_mapping.Description: task_alias: mapped by known task aliases or movie markers; unresolved: no supported task identity; ambiguous: multiple differing source/BIDS candidates

source_mat.Description: Original S3 MATLAB export URL, if present

source_csv.Description: Original S3 signal CSV URL, if present

mixed_task_starts.Description: 1: more than one distinct recognized task/block start marker; 0: checked and absent

internal_boundary.Description: 1: boundary or break cnt strictly within the sample interval; descriptive only, not a quality issue or evidence of task overlap

movie_anchor_count.Description: 1: expected movie start or stop does not occur exactly once

unknown_channel_identity.Description: 1: missing .set channel labels or the unresolved six-channel HBN layout

acquisition_fields_missing.Description: Semicolon-separated missing acquisition field names; n/a if none of the screened fields is missing

eeg_channel_count_added.Description: 1: EEGChannelCount was filled from verified channel types and .set count

issue_availability.Description: present: available status without a BIDS file, or unavailable status despite a BIDS file; absent: neither condition

upstream_data_pnts.Description: Original quality-table sample count, without recalculation

upstream_event_cnt.Description: Original quality-table event count, without recalculation

upstream_quality_checks.Description: Original quality-table quality_checks value, without reinterpretation

source_aliases.Description: Semicolon-separated original export names collapsed when task identity, source signal size and S3 ETag agree

task_start_codes.Description: Semicolon-separated distinct task/block start codes; presence does not certify complete recoverable task segments

initial_offset_unpaired.Description: 1: the first event is an offset without a preceding onset in this recording. Its label and timing are retained; hed_annotation represents it as a point event instead of an unsupported temporal interval

validation_state.Description: Per-recording validator outcome when --validate is used: pass, warning, error, not_applicable, or n/a if not run. A pass is not an EEG usability certification

validator_errors.Description: Semicolon-separated CODE:SUBCODE tokens; none if checked and no recording-level errors; n/a if not checked

validator_warnings.Description: Semicolon-separated CODE:SUBCODE tokens; none if checked and no recording-level warnings; n/a if not checked

Levels.automatic_v2: Ordered available/caution/unavailable rules documented under RecommendationRules
Levels.existing_review: Explicit recommendation retained instead of an automatic replacement

recommendation_reasons.Description: Semicolon-separated controlled reason codes. For column-name codes, consult that column value and definition; multiple caveats are retained

Levels.confirmed_unusable_signal: One of the ten explicitly inspected A15 recording IDs
Levels.no_assessed_bids_recording: No standalone EEG recording is present in the delivered collection; source-only or embedded data may still exist
Levels.unassessed_channel_identity: Channel identity is unresolved and no reviewed unusability decision exists
Levels.validation_incomplete_or_failed: EEG validation has not passed or completed; the existing recording requires caution rather than a claim of unusability
Levels.no_detected_obstacle: No caveat among the screened conditions; not evidence that all possible problems were checked
Levels.issue_a06_hed_annotation: Unresolved HED feedback association or timing interpretation
Levels.issue_a12_behavior_disagreement: Behavioral values or planned blocks disagree with events
Levels.issue_a14_event_extent: An event extends beyond the EEG interval
Levels.upstream_key_events_exist: Original checks reported absent expected events
Levels.movie_anchor_count: Expected movie markers do not each occur exactly once

Priority: unavailable for the ten inspected A15 recordings identified by release, participant and task
unavailable when no standalone EEG file is delivered for this row
caution for unresolved channel identity, incomplete/failed EEG validation or unresolved task identity
caution for present A06/A11/A12/A13/A14 issues, any established A10 overlap, non-available upstream status, missing expected events, ambiguous source mapping or abnormal movie marker counts
available otherwise: no obstacle identified by these checks
RecommendationRules.IgnoredForEEGRecommendation: Fixed metadata repairs, A08 missing acquisition facts, ordinary validator warnings, optional behavioral additions, and all ET availability/timing/missingness metrics
RecommendationRules.Limitations: No new EEG amplitude analysis is performed. Available is conditional on the screening evidence. Unavailable can mean absent from the delivered release rather than irrecoverable; use recommendation_reasons and source fields to distinguish these cases. Caution requires analysis-specific interpretation.
